title: Segments over concatenated lists
statement: Let $\mu$ map natural numbers to integers, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $l_1,l_2$ be lists of integers. The memory segment beginning at $a$ agrees with the concatenation $l_1++l_2$ if and only if it agrees with $l_1$ beginning at $a$ and with $l_2$ beginning at $a+|l_1|$.
